light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Ahora, las mezclas. Primero preparo la carpeta: una de cemento, tres de arena, como te dije.
clips.action: He pushes the shovel into the heap of sand and cement in the wheelbarrow and lifts one shovelful to show it, then drops it back.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the shovel folds the dry sand and grey cement over and over until the colour is even, a puff of cement dust.

clips.text: Después el agua, de a poco. Siempre de a poco. Es mucho más fácil agregar agua que sacarla.
clips.action: He pours a little water from the bucket into a hollow in the dry mix and turns it with the shovel, pouring slowly, stopping.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: the gloved hand squeezes the damp mortar into a lump and slowly opens, the lump keeps its shape without dripping.

clips.text: Mezcla muy aguada es mezcla débil. Queda linda al principio, y después es la que se hace polvo.
clips.action: He drops the lump back, then shakes his head and mimes crumbling something to powder between his fingers.

clips.line: ¿Y eso blanco qué es? ¿Cola de carpintero en el cemento? Tú estás loco.
clips.who: the neighbour standing in front of the camera (the fourth reference image is his face)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man; the man in the foreground does NOT speak, he only listens
clips.action: The neighbour points at the white glue bottle and then taps his temple, grinning with gruff disbelief as he says his line; the presenter in the foreground only listens.

clips.text: Cola vinílica, sí, la blanca de toda la vida. En el agua de la lechada ayuda a que lo nuevo se agarre a lo viejo.
clips.action: He laughs, picks up the white glue bottle and shakes it toward the gate, then pours a little glue into the bucket of water and stirs with a stick.

clips.text: La cantidad, la que indique el envase de tu cola para usarla con cemento. No le pongas de más pensando que pega más.
clips.action: He turns the glue bottle to read its back, tapping it with a finger, then wags the finger 'not more'.
EXTREME CLOSE-UP: cement powder is stirred into the milky water until it becomes a thick smooth grey slurry, the stick lifted to show it coats without dripping.

clips.text: Y aquí va el error número dos. El que arruina todo aunque hayas hecho bien lo demás. La lechada no se prepara toda de golpe.
clips.action: He puts the bucket down and raises two fingers, serious, then points at the bucket.

clips.text: Si la cepillas en todo el patio y te vas a preparar la carpeta, la lechada se seca. Y una lechada seca no pega: separa.
clips.action: He sweeps his arm over the whole wet floor, then mimes brushing, then walks two steps away toward the wheelbarrow and turns back shaking his head.

clips.text: Se trabaja por partes. Un pedazo de lechada, e inmediatamente la carpeta encima. Fresca sobre fresca. Siempre.
clips.action: He chops the air with his flat hand into small sections, one after the other, then presses both palms together.
